0.1 This Indian Standard ( Second Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 28 August 1980, after the draft finalized by the Fire Fighting Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council. 0.2 Thi. standard hal been formulated to help in production of combined key. of proper specification. This standard was originally published in 1958 and revised in 1972. In this revision two designs, which are currently manufactured in' the country have been specified. 0.'
